visual_events.description: The camera moves slowly forward along an angled exterior wall of a finished building constructed with exposed, unpainted light-reddish terracotta bricks and neat recessed mortar joints. In the lower left foreground from 0.0s to about 2.5s, a deep-red painted brick arch frames a decorative circular opening containing green glass bottles set radially into the masonry, which gradually exits the left edge of the frame as the camera advances. The main wall shows alternating long and short brick faces consistent with brick-on-edge bonding, along with a diagonal pattern of small rectangular ventilation openings near the upper middle. To the right, a deeper-red painted brick porch or entrance structure features a curved barrel-vaulted roof and a stepped corbelled brick arch over entrance steps. Beyond the porch on the right, a bare dirt yard with fallen leaves, a low grey-and-red masonry bench, a circular concrete well or planter ring, and green trees are visible.
